+ # 🎨 Frontend Wizard Integration Guide
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ This guide provides comprehensive instructions for implementing the latest wizard changes in your frontend application. The backend has been enhanced with improved order data structure, design snapshot storage, and automatic page/section counting.
+ 
+ ## 🚀 Key Changes Summary
+ 
+ ### 1. Enhanced Order Data Structure
+ - **New `sessionId` field**: Stores session reference for better tracking
+ - **`design_snapshot` storage**: Complete design data stored as JSON
+ - **Automatic page/section counting**: Backend extracts `total_pages` and `total_sections` from design
+ 
+ ### 2. Improved Data Flow
+ - Better user ID mapping and fallback logic
+ - Enhanced error handling and validation
+ - Comprehensive design data preservation
+ 
+ ## 📋 Implementation Steps
+ 
+ ### Step 1: Update Order Creation Interface
+ 
+ #### 1.1 Update TypeScript Interfaces
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // types/wizard.ts
+ export interface CompleteOrderRequest {
+   session_id: string;
+   user_id?: string; // Optional - will be set by backend if not provided
+   order: {
+     title: string;
+     description: string;
+     priceTomans: number;
+     comments?: string;
+     site_type?: 'personal' | 'business';
+     user_id?: string;
+   };
+   design_snapshot: {
+     website_framework: WebsiteFramework;
+     branding: Branding;
+     additional_services: AdditionalServices;
+     domains: Domains;
+     pricing: Pricing;
+     paymentOptions: PaymentOptions;
+     // Include any other design data
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ export interface OrderResponse {
+   success: boolean;
+   order_id: string;
+   invoiceId: string;
+   message: string;
+   order: {
+     id: string;
+     title: string;
+     description: string;
+     price: number;
+     status: string;
+     user_id: string;
+     created_at: string;
+     updated_at: string;
+   };
+   invoice: {
+     id: string;
+     order_id: string;
+     user_id: string;
+     amount: number;
+     dueDate: string;
+     status: string;
+     description: string;
+     created_at: string;
+     updated_at: string;
+   };
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### 1.2 Update API Service
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // services/wizardService.ts
+ export class WizardService {
+   private apiUrl = '/api/wizard';
+ 
+   async completeOrder(orderData: CompleteOrderRequest): Promise<OrderResponse> {
+     try {
+       const response = await fetch(`${this.apiUrl}/complete-order`, {
+         method: 'POST',
+         headers: {
+           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+           'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.getAuthToken()}`,
+         },
+         body: JSON.stringify(orderData),
+       });
+ 
+       if (!response.ok) {
+         throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
+       }
+ 
+       return await response.json();
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Error completing order:', error);
+       throw error;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   private getAuthToken(): string {
+     // Implement your token retrieval logic
+     return localStorage.getItem('authToken') || '';
+   }
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Step 2: Update Wizard Component
+ 
+ #### 2.1 Enhanced Wizard State Management
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // components/Wizard/WizardContainer.tsx
+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { WizardService } from '../../services/wizardService';
+ 
+ interface WizardState {
+   currentStep: number;
+   sessionId: string;
+   userId?: string;
+   designData: {
+     website_framework: any;
+     branding: any;
+     additional_services: any;
+     domains: any;
+     pricing: any;
+     paymentOptions: any;
+   };
+   orderData: {
+     title: string;
+     description: string;
+     priceTomans: number;
+     comments?: string;
+     site_type?: 'personal' | 'business';
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ export const WizardContainer: React.FC = () => {
+   const [wizardState, setWizardState] = useState<WizardState>({
+     currentStep: 0,
+     sessionId: '',
+     designData: {
+       website_framework: {},
+       branding: {},
+       additional_services: {},
+       domains: {},
+       pricing: {},
+       paymentOptions: {},
+     },
+     orderData: {
+       title: '',
+       description: '',
+       priceTomans: 0,
+     },
+   });
+ 
+   const wizardService = new WizardService();
+ 
+   // Initialize session ID on component mount
+   useEffect(() => {
+     const sessionId = generateSessionId();
+     setWizardState(prev => ({ ...prev, sessionId }));
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const generateSessionId = (): string => {
+     return `wizard_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
+   };
+ 
+   const updateDesignData = (step: string, data: any) => {
+     setWizardState(prev => ({
+       ...prev,
+       designData: {
+         ...prev.designData,
+         [step]: data,
+       },
+     }));
+   };
+ 
+   const updateOrderData = (data: Partial<WizardState['orderData']>) => {
+     setWizardState(prev => ({
+       ...prev,
+       orderData: {
+         ...prev.orderData,
+         ...data,
+       },
+     }));
+   };
+ 
+   const completeOrder = async () => {
+     try {
+       const orderRequest: CompleteOrderRequest = {
+         session_id: wizardState.sessionId,
+         user_id: wizardState.userId, // Will be set by backend if not provided
+         order: wizardState.orderData,
+         design_snapshot: wizardState.designData,
+       };
+ 
+       const response = await wizardService.completeOrder(orderRequest);
+       
+       // Handle successful order completion
+       console.log('Order completed successfully:', response);
+       
+       // Redirect to order confirmation or payment page
+       window.location.href = `/orders/${response.order_id}/payment`;
+       
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Failed to complete order:', error);
+       // Handle error (show error message, retry, etc.)
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <div className="wizard-container">
+       {/* Your wizard steps components */}
+     </div>
+   );
+ };
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Step 3: Update Individual Wizard Steps

+ #### 3.1 Website Framework Step
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // components/Wizard/Steps/WebsiteFrameworkStep.tsx
+ import React from 'react';
+ 
+ interface WebsiteFrameworkStepProps {
+   data: any;
+   onUpdate: (data: any) => void;
+   onNext: () => void;
+ }
+ 
+ export const WebsiteFrameworkStep: React.FC<WebsiteFrameworkStepProps> = ({
+   data,
+   onUpdate,
+   onNext,
+ }) => {
+   const [formData, setFormData] = useState(data);
+ 
+   const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
+     e.preventDefault();
+     onUpdate(formData);
+     onNext();
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="wizard-step">
+       <h2>Website Framework</h2>
+       
+       <div className="form-group">
+         <label>Design Method</label>
+         <select
+           value={formData.designMethod || 'template'}
+           onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({
+             ...prev,
+             designMethod: e.target.value
+           }))}
+         >
+           <option value="template">Template-based</option>
+           <option value="dynamic">Dynamic Design</option>
+         </select>
+       </div>
+ 
+       {formData.designMethod === 'dynamic' && (
+         <div className="dynamic-design-section">
+           {/* Dynamic design configuration */}
+         </div>
+       )}
+ 
+       <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">
+         Continue
+       </button>
+     </form>
+   );
+ };
+ ```

+ ### Step 4: Implement Order Summary Component
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // components/Wizard/OrderSummary.tsx
+ import React from 'react';
+ 
+ interface OrderSummaryProps {
+   orderData: any;
+   designData: any;
+   onComplete: () => void;
+ }
+ 
+ export const OrderSummary: React.FC<OrderSummaryProps> = ({
+   orderData,
+   designData,
+   onComplete,
+ }) => {
+   const calculateTotalPages = (designData: any): number => {
+     if (designData.website_framework?.dynamicDesign?.pages) {
+       return designData.website_framework.dynamicDesign.pages.length;
+     }
+     return 1; // Default to 1 page for template-based designs
+   };
+ 
+   const calculateTotalSections = (designData: any): number => {
+     if (designData.website_framework?.dynamicDesign?.pages) {
+       return designData.website_framework.dynamicDesign.pages.reduce(
+         (total: number, page: any) => total + (page.sections?.length || 0),
+         0
+       );
+     }
+     return 0;
+   };
+ 
+   const totalPages = calculateTotalPages(designData);
+   const totalSections = calculateTotalSections(designData);
+ 
+   return (
+     <div className="order-summary">
+       <h2>Order Summary</h2>
+       
+       <div className="summary-section">
+         <h3>Project Details</h3>
+         <p><strong>Title:</strong> {orderData.title}</p>
+         <p><strong>Description:</strong> {orderData.description}</p>
+         <p><strong>Site Type:</strong> {orderData.site_type}</p>
+         <p><strong>Total Pages:</strong> {totalPages}</p>
+         <p><strong>Total Sections:</strong> {totalSections}</p>
+       </div>
+ 
+       <div className="summary-section">
+         <h3>Design Configuration</h3>
+         <p><strong>Design Method:</strong> {designData.website_framework?.designMethod}</p>
+         <p><strong>Primary Color:</strong> {designData.branding?.primaryColor}</p>
+         <p><strong>Font Family:</strong> {designData.branding?.fontFamily}</p>
+       </div>
+ 
+       <div className="summary-section">
+         <h3>Pricing</h3>
+         <p><strong>Total Price:</strong> {orderData.priceTomans.toLocaleString()} Tomans</p>
+       </div>
+ 
+       <button onClick={onComplete} className="btn-primary">
+         Complete Order
+       </button>
+     </div>
+   );
+ };
+ ```

+ ### Step 5: Add Error Handling and Loading States
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // components/Wizard/WizardErrorBoundary.tsx
+ import React, { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
+ 
+ interface Props {
+   children: ReactNode;
+ }
+ 
+ interface State {
+   hasError: boolean;
+   error?: Error;
+ }
+ 
+ export class WizardErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
+   public state: State = {
+     hasError: false,
+   };
+ 
+   public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
+     return { hasError: true, error };
+   }
+ 
+   public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
+     console.error('Wizard error:', error, errorInfo);
+   }
+ 
+   public render() {
+     if (this.state.hasError) {
+       return (
+         <div className="error-boundary">
+           <h2>Something went wrong</h2>
+           <p>Please try refreshing the page or contact support.</p>
+           <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
+             Refresh Page
+           </button>
+         </div>
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     return this.props.children;
+   }
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Step 6: Implement Session Management
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // utils/sessionManager.ts
+ export class SessionManager {
+   private static readonly SESSION_KEY = 'wizard_session';
+   private static readonly SESSION_TIMEOUT = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours
+ 
+   static createSession(): string {
+     const sessionId = `wizard_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
+     const sessionData = {
+       id: sessionId,
+       createdAt: Date.now(),
+       expiresAt: Date.now() + this.SESSION_TIMEOUT,
+     };
+ 
+     localStorage.setItem(this.SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(sessionData));
+     return sessionId;
+   }
+ 
+   static getSession(): string | null {
+     const sessionData = localStorage.getItem(this.SESSION_KEY);
+     if (!sessionData) return null;
+ 
+     try {
+       const session = JSON.parse(sessionData);
+       if (Date.now() > session.expiresAt) {
+         this.clearSession();
+         return null;
+       }
+       return session.id;
+     } catch {
+       this.clearSession();
+       return null;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   static clearSession(): void {
+     localStorage.removeItem(this.SESSION_KEY);
+   }
+ 
+   static isSessionValid(): boolean {
+     return this.getSession() !== null;
+   }
+ }
+ ```
